name: USDU Finance
oneLiner: USDU is USDU Finance's DAO-minted dollar backed by Morpho and Curve vault shares after a sharp supply wind-down.
collateral: Adapter-held positions: Curve USDU/USDC LP tokens, Morpho USDU Core vault shares (curated lending), and TermMax USDU vault shares (fixed-term lending) as on-chain backing
pegMechanism: Protocol-minted via DAO-approved adapters; convertible to USDC via Curve pools

notices.title: Post-wind-down collateral coverage
notices.message: USDU Finance's transparency page currently reports roughly 100% collateralization after a sharp supply wind-down, with backing concentrated in Morpho USDU Core vault shares and Curve USDU/USDC LP tokens.

notices.title: Conflicting issuer disclosures
notices.message: USDU Finance's live transparency endpoint now reports backing approximately equal to circulating supply after the wind-down. Treat exact collateralization and allocation figures as live-snapshot values because supply and adapter balances have moved materially.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USDU Finance's exact Ethereum ERC-20 0xdde3ec717f220fc6a29d6a4be73f91da5b718e55 is a protocol-position liability, not a direct fiat or borrower-CDP claim. Issuer disclosure identifies adapter-owned Curve LP and lending-vault shares; independently verified Ethereum block 26098837 establishes three valid modules, including user-callable USDC/USDT SwapBridgeMorphoV1 exits. Fresh block 26099926 confirms those three remain valid and their deployed runtime matches verified source. Holder rights are operational and conditional on module/vault resources; complete external asset valuation, matching liabilities, residual module allocation, custody and funded recovery remain unresolved.
